items.description: Goodneighbor is a platform that allows you to define, run and manage Twitter avatars, totally autonomous Twitter identities that manage their own Twitter accounts, concerned with any subject matter and interested in any topic.

In a few clicks, adds an official Twitter Button to your WordPress site that you can change to target any hashtag you want. When clicked, it preformats a tweet that includes a bitly link back to your article so that your readers can send your content into Twitter on relevant hashtags - increasing your social traffic.
A site that lets you discover content shared on the social Web and create clean and uncluttered dashboards of hot content.
DealSauce lets you organize and share all the great deals you find on the web. People use boards to organize their wishlists, plan their gift shopping, or just shop for great deals.
QuickResu.me makes it super-simple to build a mobile resume linked to a QR code.
Simple surveys to share with friends through Twitter, sms or email. Anywhere you can paste text, you can give a wedgie (a simple survey).
A fun method to learn and improve your foreign languages like English, French or Italian through music and typing-in song lyrics.
Service that motivates and rewards people for being active.

EmbedPlus allows you to seamlessly and freely upgrade video embeds with attractive features that popular video players do not currently offer. Given a YouTube link and a few seconds, our first release applies APIs to generate enhanced embed code that adds features like: familiar DVD-like controls, section cutting/chopping, real-time Internet reactions, third-party annotations, and more. We think that EmbedPlus could be useful to bloggers, commenters, and anyone wanting to offer viewers more without having to actually alter original video content.

Enter 1 song, get 150 similar songs back, create your own MTV. Combines Last.FM & Youtube. There's also a Facebook integration that let you discover music your friends like. Uses Bit.ly in order to share playlist urls.

Kukunu is a new travel planning experience that simplifies the life of travellers around the world. Travelers can collaborate to create their itinerary then add transports, hotels, restaurants, activities and sights across the cities they plan to visit.
Sportmeets connects online users who love sports so that they can meet, organize their teams and events and compete offline.
Mobile web applications let you share location info as signature to the messages in email and SMS.
BILD.de auf Ihrem Desktop - Nachrichten genau nach Ihrem Geschmack. Note: this application is available in German only.
GdRd is a Twitter bot that fetches a book's rating on Goodreads.com. Just mention/@reply @GdRd with the ISBN number of a book and GdRd will reply with the book's rating.
An artist-based radio, with information and photos about the currently playing artist. Pulls data from Last.fm and YouTube.

Compare Google and the webs 7 other top search engines side by side. bit.ly API creates bit.ly URL for quick copy and paste, or use the TweetIt feature to post your search terms and bit.ly URL directly to your Twitter account.
GeoChirp helps you search real time for people Twittering for specific things in a specific area. Translate tweets in any language. You can even search Twitter globally for anything.
Identify pills using your phone or IM client. Pillbox will ask you a series of questions about your pill to help you identify it.
Am I paying too much in rent? How much should I pay to rent this apartment? What did it rent for before me? How much are my neighbors paying for their apartments?

Find apartments and houses for rent in Canada on your Android while walking down a neighborhood that you like or while commuting to work or school. Call or email landlords with a single touch and if you like a rental share it on Facebook or Twitter.
nthCaller allows you to run 'caller number --' contests from your computer. Just pick a number and the winning call will be transferred to your phone.

This Google Maps mashup lets you see an outline of one part of the world overlayed on another part of the world. For example, you can sketch an outline of New Jersey in the Reference Map then overlay the outline over Japan in the Comparison Map.
It's twitter translated to 40+ languages.
Personal twitter space for getting-things-done (GTD).
GoodReader is a PDF previewing application for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to view files in their Box accounts within GoodReader.
Risk evolved into massive Google Maps game with 55 million cells and instant action Arena tournaments.
Plots the location of over 130 zoos, safari parks, butterfly farms and other wildlife attractions throughout the UK.
Spilt screen with half OS OpenSpace API and half Google Maps API.

Cardinal Maps is an online mapping company that focuses on creating maps for commercial distribution and marketing purposes. Some of the maps that Cardinal Maps create include tourism maps, events maps, bike maps, and business maps.
Most popular trends on Twitter aggregator.
Shows US neighborhood boundaries and neighborhood names, pulling from Maponics Neighborhood Boundaries GIS mapping data.
ScanTheNet is a search mashup that aggregates results from Flickr, Instagram, Twitter and Youtube. Discover The Net Live & Share Interesting Content.
The DC stands for DonorsChoose (not District of Columbia). This site lets you sign up for alerts for when classrooms in your interest area need donations.
Uses the Twitter API to download and analyze US Polticians' twitter data. Uses jQuery libraries to create on-demand word clouds for parties and politicians.
Generate a tag cloud from music artists similar to the one you submit. Use it find find new bands you like. Including YouTube music videos.
ikasis is a YouTube video player. You can search for videos without reloading and breaking the actual video. The search result is played like a playlist. This is non-stop YouTube, like watching TV.
Search popular products via the Commission Junction network with this application. Winner of the CJ mashup developer contest.

Elsy Arres Flights is a web application that lets users search for upcoming flights by providing their departure location, and their destination. This application uses the Elsy Arres Flights API service.

For on-the-go administrators to access data from their mobile devices. Analytics app company youcalc has created an embeddable Key Metrics Change web widget that displays well on the iPhone as a web app.
Use pixurl to search your favorite social platforms all from one web page

CouponFollow tracks coupon codes that have been tweeted by Twitter users in real-time, and organizes them for bargain shoppers to use. Coupon popularity is tracked by the total number of Tweets. Members can easily retweet codes they like via Twitter.
Create your tweets and post them at any future date and time.
Japanese mashup combining videos and Google Maps.
Rules of thumb in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year contains an interesting rule of thumb from business, real estate, finance, fashion, sports, and more.
Retailer of overstocks and closeouts uses the Google Checkout API.
Give away the junk that is cluttering up your life or find stuff you really need for free.
lite news -noun 1. A word cloud created from the most frequently used words in Google News.

Search and view Flickr photoset slideshows in cool 3D layouts: Cover Flow, Carousel, Grid, Spiral, Roller Coaster, and Time Machine. Powered by OpenFlux 3D, aka PlexiGlass. Includes large photo view, full screen mode, thumbnail strip and photo shuffling.
DARAO is a YouTube viewer for lazybones. DARAO plays YouTube featured movies automatically without clicks.
This mashup is a one stop shop for Synonym finding. It uses the synonyms API.
Preview what every one is stumbling upon in StumbleUpon. Dynamically add or remove tabs for the tag of your interest from tag cloud.

The Abios Desktop Stream Viewer Mashup is a Qt5 application that uses streamlink and libVLC callbacks to play live video streams. It allows users to access streamlink API’s stream data and libVLC API’s full coverage.
A tool developed by the Nexmo community that will make it super easy to blast your SMS campaign from a simple Excel file.
Kinoma Play is a social media browser for smartphones, and this mashup allows Box.net users to access their accounts from within Kinoma.
Displays all Montreal subway statons and lines. Markers are placed very accurate. Can display lines separately.
Cloud PBX is a PBX system on the cloud for Indian businesses.
An restaurant mashup based on Google maps. The locator allows visitors to search restaurants by keyword or category. It is also possible to search for restaurants located in a given neighborhood.
Produces graphs of how often things are mentioned on guardian.co.uk.

e-TXT Solutions is a web-based system that uses a process which combines text, mobile payments, gift, and loyalty cards into one integrated system. This system allows non-profits and political organizations to advertise/promote their campaigns/causes to raise money on a global scale.
Find the closest OnAIR bus stop to where you live and the current weather at that location
See how reddit comments, votes and articles are added to the homepage or subpages of reddit in a realtime stream.

EtsyEspy is a buyer's tool for browsing the vast collection of listings available on Etsy. Select a filter, then EtsyEpsy will display listings in a Photo gallery. Runs either in your browser window or in full screen mode. Moving your cursor over hidden listings will bring them to the top. If there's a particular listing of interest, click on it and the listing's Etsy page loads.

iPrimr makes it easy for members of Amazon Prime to find items eligible for free shipping. With so many items on Amazon coming from third party sellers, this tool filters out all non-prime-eligible items.
Home and garden furniture, furnishings, and accessories. Includes range of products from some major retailers from around UK, DE, FR, AU and USA.
Speaks the details about your local weather. Uses Google's secret Weather API that is part of the Google Homepage
Online running log service with local search and sharing using Google maps. Running log has nice graphing features.
Google Map of strip clubs across the United States. Adult content, Not Safe For Work, NSFW.
so audible cloud music player, sync your tracks share with friends upload, quick share embed, html5, ipad, iphone, android, play music anywhere long mixes, meetings, sermons, podcasts, radio

Web widgets that display Amazon items and earn referral revenue through Amazon Associates. Browser is an Amazon mini browser. List displays wish lists, baby and wedding registries, List Mania lists. Latest and Greatest shows bestsellers and new releases.
Unusual use of the Google Maps API to control a non-Google map, in this case from the game World of Warcraft. It behaves just a like a Google Map using zoom, pan and drag controls.
The Internet TV charts tracks the most popular online video clips each week from four leading Internet TV sites. All the best video clips, on one page.

Greener pastures ranks U.S. cities based on the greenness of their available housing stock. In a graph, each line represent a city's greenness over time. You can hover over a line to see which city it represents and compare.
Share photos on Twitter with TwitPic.
An extension to CloudShout. Lists all current visitors to your blog that have provided their LastFM username. Clicking on them plays their LastFM library.

Visual Traceroute is a web application that enables users to trace the path packets take through the Internet, by entering the URL. This application uses ipinfo.io API for geolocation and ISP details.
See the recipients of Stimulus Dollars in your state. Replace the 2 letter state code at the end of the URL with your state code.

Zuckerbucks are points that you can use like play money on Facebook. They have no cash value, but you can send them to friends as gifts, or as payment. You can also bid on real products featured within the Zuckerbucks app.
Find celebrity videos, especially for Latin stars. Uses the YouTube API. Note that some videos are adult content and not safe for work, NSFW.
U.S. Election 2008 application that blends Silverlight 1.0, AJAX, ASP.NET, and Virtual Earth. Provides biographies, images, links, and feeds for presidential candidates.

OggChat is a live chat solution for website support and sales that integrates with Google Talk and GMail. It incorporates features such as custom chat windows and skills based routing, but routes all chats directly to each operator's Google Talk acc
A mashup of 100 cities and their weather forecasts from weatherunderground.com. The 100 cities listed are the cities where history shows you are most likely to sweat while there.
MapMyEvent is a portal that delivers map information for any event along with information about hotels and landmarks around it. You can use Mapmyevent to generate customized link for your own events.
An interactive map to find and add ping pong tables worldwide. For the animation, jQuery was used. The app is optimized for iPhone/iPod Touch as well.
Allows runners to create and save custom running routes.
Ransomizr creates a randomly generated font from single-letter Flickr images and allows you to immediately compose and save ransom-letter-style notes.

RADAAR is a powerful social media management and collaboration platform designed for handling multiple brands. It helps marketers at every step, from scheduling and publishing posts on their profiles to analyzing their efforts. Whether you're a small business focusing on a few social media networks, an agency managing multiple brands, or an enterprise company that needs it all, RADAAR will help you drastically streamline your workflows, simplify your social media management, and save time. RADAAR provides a variety of features including tools for publishing, social media inbox, social media monitoring, and analytics.
Shop home furnishing items across 2 million products and 20 stores. Uses APIs from Commission Junction and Shopping.com.

This website gives you an easy interface to the App.net API. First you sign-up using your AppNet account. After sign-up you can use the console to try API queries and see the result in both JSON and rendered views.
If you need a pint in Folkestone UK this Google Map can help you find the right pub.
Quickly find campus buildings with this campus map of the University of Texas at Austin.
Places 1,909,615 Cell Towers and Antennas onto Google Maps to determine cell reception in an area.
Find useful information about Singapore places
A mashup like housingmaps.com. It shows the latest flats for sale or rental in Singapore on Google maps.

This Firefox extension provides an user friendly interface for the Amazon S3 storage service. Its interface is very much similar to the FTP interface that lists local folders in the left panel and S3 buckets, files and folders in the right panel.
vspotz is a hyper-local event search engine. Other available event search engines typically focus on major cities, however, vspotz is committed to having the most local search results.

LyricStatus allows you to share your favorite lyrics with your Facebook friends. Simply highlight your favorite lines from a song and post straight to Facebook as a status. You can post lyrics to your own wall, or you can utilize the Facebook Graph API to post to your friends' wall.

Sky Connect Mission Management Unit provides GPS tracking, satellite telephone, and text messaging capabilities in flight. Data is transferred between aircraft and Sky Connect via the 66 low-orbit satellites in the Iridium satellite network.
Italian public jobs search engine and map. The jobs are grabbed from the Gazzetta Ufficiale.
Drag and drop DVDs recommendations. You put them into buckets for those you love, hate, or have not seen. Then based on your choices the site makes recommendations to you.

SOSMS is an app that connects disaster survivors with family members and friends. Sign up for an account, add contacts (people to be notified) and text SAFE to the SOSMS number provided to notify your contacts.

myMeetingTime is a tool for helping people connect across time zones. Leveraging timezone data from IANA (via TimezoneDB) and mashing it up with geo location names from GeoNames, myMeetingTime is displayed in a graphical interface, making it easy to use.

WordPress plugin that lets you embed various Facebook objects by just pasting the URL anywhere in a post or page content. Supports Facebook albums, events, notes, videos, groups, pages, and individual pictures.
A lightweight diary of books you've used and to share it with friends. Integrated with Amazon's catalog and Facebook. Hosted on Heroku.
This tool shows the real-time position of Princess Cruises ships. Many ships feature a live webcam stream.

Elseif is the hangout place for developers, programmers and hackers. Come and watch the curated set of screencasts and explore and discover the wonderful world of repositories. Contents are curated in a way that is easy to find.

RinkAtlas provides door-to-door directions to ice rinks in North America. The database currently includes over 1,800 ice hockey and figure skating facilities in the 50 U.S. states and Puerto Rico. Rinks in Canada will be added in the future.
SugarCRM is an online customer relationship management application, and its integration with Box.net allows SugarCRM users to view their content on Box within the SugarCRM environment.
